summary: Modern Python architecture with good separation of concerns but critical gaps for banking modernization objectives. Missing legacy VB6 integration components and banking-specific security controls.

hotspots.reason: No VB6 or legacy banking components detected despite business objectives requiring retail banking modernization

provenance.evidence: 290 files scanned, no VB6 (.frm, .frx, .bas, .cls) or banking-specific components found

hotspots.reason: No banking-grade authentication or authorization mechanisms detected for customer onboarding and account access

provenance.evidence: Security engineer agent exists but no banking auth implementation detected

hotspots.reason: File-based JSON storage insufficient for banking transaction integrity and ACID compliance

provenance.evidence: JSON file-based storage detected, no database connections found

hotspots.reason: No deposit, withdrawal, or balance inquiry transaction handlers detected

provenance.evidence: No banking transaction processing components found in 290 scanned files

risks.title: Architecture-Business Objective Mismatch
risks.description: Current system is a software modernization platform, not a retail banking application. Missing all core banking components required for stated objectives.

risks.title: Regulatory Compliance Gap
risks.description: No banking compliance, audit trails, or regulatory reporting mechanisms detected for retail banking operations.

risks.title: Data Security Vulnerability
risks.description: File-based storage and lack of encryption mechanisms inappropriate for banking customer data and financial transactions.

risks.title: Legacy Migration Path Undefined
risks.description: No clear integration or migration path from legacy VB6 banking systems to current Python architecture.
